🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Küche (In the kitchen)

die Tasse = cup
das Glas = glass
der Löffel = spoon
die Gabel = fork
das Messer = knife
der Topf = pot

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
